podcast.title: White's Lemonade Ad (1973)
podcast.body: In 1973, Ross McManus recorded a jingle for a White's Lemonade TV advert, with his son Elvis singing backup. "in 1973, Elvis sang backup for his father on this ad for our White's Lemonade."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia

podcast.title: Ambition for Hit Parade Success
podcast.body: In Elvis Costello's own recollection, his father Ross "would try anything to get over on the hit parade," exemplified by a "delightfully cheesy, televised ring-a-ding-ding performance" in 1963 of the Pete Seeger folk-standard "If I Had a Hammer," and his work recording jingles for TV adverts. "father Ross would try anything to get over on the hit parade."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia

podcast.title: Elvis Costello's Father
podcast.body: Ross McManus was the father of Declan Patrick McManus, famously known as Elvis Costello. "the son of British Irish band leader and vocalist Ross McManus."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
